en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华晓谕摩西、亚伦说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：

en.text: “The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers’ houses. They shall encamp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it.

zhSimplified.text: 「以色列人要各归自己的纛下，在本族的旗号那里，对着会幕的四围安营。

zhTraditional.text: 「以色列人要各歸自己的纛下，在本族的旗號那裏，對着會幕的四圍安營。

en.text: “Those who encamp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

zhSimplified.text: 在东边，向日出之地，照着军队安营的是犹大营的纛。有亚米拿达的儿子拿顺作犹大人的首领。

zhTraditional.text: 在東邊，向日出之地，照着軍隊安營的是猶大營的纛。有亞米拿達的兒子拿順作猶大人的首領。

en.text: His division, and those who were counted of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

zhSimplified.text: 他军队被数的，共有七万四千六百名。

zhTraditional.text: 他軍隊被數的，共有七萬四千六百名。

en.text: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.

zhSimplified.text: 挨着他安营的是以萨迦支派。有苏押的儿子拿坦业作以萨迦人的首领。

zhTraditional.text: 挨着他安營的是以薩迦支派。有蘇押的兒子拿坦業作以薩迦人的首領。

en.text: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

zhSimplified.text: 他军队被数的，共有五万四千四百名。

zhTraditional.text: 他軍隊被數的，共有五萬四千四百名。

en.text: “The tribe of Zebulun: the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.

zhSimplified.text: 又有西布伦支派。希伦的儿子以利押作西布伦人的首领。

zhTraditional.text: 又有西布倫支派。希倫的兒子以利押作西布倫人的首領。

en.text: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

zhSimplified.text: 他军队被数的，共有五万七千四百名。

zhTraditional.text: 他軍隊被數的，共有五萬七千四百名。

en.text: “All who were counted of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out first.

zhSimplified.text: 凡属犹大营、按着军队被数的，共有十八万六千四百名，要作第一队往前行。

zhTraditional.text: 凡屬猶大營、按着軍隊被數的，共有十八萬六千四百名，要作第一隊往前行。

en.text: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.

zhSimplified.text: 「在南边，按着军队是吕便营的纛。有示丢珥的儿子以利蓿作吕便人的首领。

zhTraditional.text: 「在南邊，按着軍隊是呂便營的纛。有示丟珥的兒子以利蓿作呂便人的首領。

en.text: His division, and those who were counted of it, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

zhSimplified.text: 他军队被数的，共有四万六千五百名。

zhTraditional.text: 他軍隊被數的，共有四萬六千五百名。

en.text: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

zhSimplified.text: 挨着他安营的是西缅支派。苏利沙代的儿子示路蔑作西缅人的首领。

zhTraditional.text: 挨着他安營的是西緬支派。蘇利沙代的兒子示路蔑作西緬人的首領。

en.text: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

zhSimplified.text: 他军队被数的，共有五万九千三百名。

zhTraditional.text: 他軍隊被數的，共有五萬九千三百名。

en.text: “The tribe of Gad: the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

zhSimplified.text: 又有迦得支派。丢珥的儿子以利雅萨作迦得人的首领。

zhTraditional.text: 又有迦得支派。丟珥的兒子以利雅薩作迦得人的首領。

en.text: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

zhSimplified.text: 他军队被数的，共有四万五千六百五十名，

zhTraditional.text: 他軍隊被數的，共有四萬五千六百五十名，

en.text: “All who were counted of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, according to their armies. They shall set out second.

zhSimplified.text: 凡属吕便营、按着军队被数的，共有十五万一千四百五十名，要作第二队往前行。

zhTraditional.text: 凡屬呂便營、按着軍隊被數的，共有十五萬一千四百五十名，要作第二隊往前行。

en.text: “Then the Tent of Meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the middle of the camps. As they encamp, so shall they set out, every man in his place, by their standards.

zhSimplified.text: 「随后，会幕要往前行，有利未营在诸营中间。他们怎样安营就怎样往前行，各按本位，各归本纛。

zhTraditional.text: 「隨後，會幕要往前行，有利未營在諸營中間。他們怎樣安營就怎樣往前行，各按本位，各歸本纛。

en.text: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

zhSimplified.text: 「在西边，按着军队是以法莲营的纛。亚米忽的儿子以利沙玛作以法莲人的首领。

zhTraditional.text: 「在西邊，按着軍隊是以法蓮營的纛。亞米忽的兒子以利沙瑪作以法蓮人的首領。

en.text: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty thousand five hundred.

zhSimplified.text: 他军队被数的，共有四万零五百名。

zhTraditional.text: 他軍隊被數的，共有四萬零五百名。

en.text: “Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh. The prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

zhSimplified.text: 挨着他的是玛拿西支派。比大蓿的儿子迦玛列作玛拿西人的首领。

zhTraditional.text: 挨着他的是瑪拿西支派。比大蓿的兒子迦瑪列作瑪拿西人的首領。

en.text: His division, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

zhSimplified.text: 他军队被数的，共有三万二千二百名。

zhTraditional.text: 他軍隊被數的，共有三萬二千二百名。

en.text: “The tribe of Benjamin: the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

zhSimplified.text: 又有便雅悯支派。基多尼的儿子亚比但作便雅悯人的首领。

zhTraditional.text: 又有便雅憫支派。基多尼的兒子亞比但作便雅憫人的首領。

en.text: His army, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

zhSimplified.text: 他军队被数的，共有三万五千四百名。

zhTraditional.text: 他軍隊被數的，共有三萬五千四百名。

en.text: “All who were counted of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out third.

zhSimplified.text: 凡属以法莲营、按着军队被数的，共有十万零八千一百名，要作第三队往前行。

zhTraditional.text: 凡屬以法蓮營、按着軍隊被數的，共有十萬零八千一百名，要作第三隊往前行。

en.text: “On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

zhSimplified.text: 「在北边，按着军队是但营的纛。亚米沙代的儿子亚希以谢作但人的首领。

zhTraditional.text: 「在北邊，按着軍隊是但營的纛。亞米沙代的兒子亞希以謝作但人的首領。

en.text: His division, and those who were counted of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

zhSimplified.text: 他军队被数的，共有六万二千七百名。

zhTraditional.text: 他軍隊被數的，共有六萬二千七百名。

en.text: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher. The prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.

zhSimplified.text: 挨着他安营的是亚设支派。俄兰的儿子帕结作亚设人的首领。

zhTraditional.text: 挨着他安營的是亞設支派。俄蘭的兒子帕結作亞設人的首領。

en.text: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

zhSimplified.text: 他军队被数的，共有四万一千五百名。

zhTraditional.text: 他軍隊被數的，共有四萬一千五百名。

en.text: “The tribe of Naphtali: the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

zhSimplified.text: 又有拿弗他利支派。以南的儿子亚希拉作拿弗他利人的首领。

zhTraditional.text: 又有拿弗他利支派。以南的兒子亞希拉作拿弗他利人的首領。

en.text: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

zhSimplified.text: 他军队被数的，共有五万三千四百名。

zhTraditional.text: 他軍隊被數的，共有五萬三千四百名。

en.text: “All who were counted of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last by their standards.”

zhSimplified.text: 凡但营被数的，共有十五万七千六百名，要归本纛作末队往前行。」

zhTraditional.text: 凡但營被數的，共有十五萬七千六百名，要歸本纛作末隊往前行。」

en.text: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were counted of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

zhSimplified.text: 这些以色列人，照他们的宗族，按他们的军队，在诸营中被数的，共有六十万零三千五百五十名。

zhTraditional.text: 這些以色列人，照他們的宗族，按他們的軍隊，在諸營中被數的，共有六十萬零三千五百五十名。

en.text: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.

zhSimplified.text: 惟独利未人没有数在以色列人中，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。

zhTraditional.text: 惟獨利未人沒有數在以色列人中，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。

en.text: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人就这样行，各人照他们的家室、宗族归于本纛，安营起行，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人就這樣行，各人照他們的家室、宗族歸於本纛，安營起行，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
